audit_items.proof_trace: MaxBlobCommitmentsPerBlock is set to U4096, which appears inconsistent with Ethereum consensus specs (mainnet preset typically uses 16, not 4096). While all current blob_schedule entries (15, 21) are below 4096, the type-level constant itself may be incorrectly set. If U4096 is wrong and should be U16, then blob_schedule entries with max_blobs_per_block=21 violate the invariant.
audit_items.attack_scenario: If MaxBlobCommitmentsPerBlock should actually be 16 (per consensus specs), configurations with blob_schedule entries >16 create inconsistency: blocks with 21 blobs pass runtime checks but may violate SSZ capacity constraints or consensus assumptions, potentially causing chain splits or consensus failures.
